summary: A luxury Yorkville townhouse setting and complimentary consultations are strengths, but mixed booking links and thin proof appear to cost you bookings.

findings.problem: The header Book Now appears to go to the reservations homepage while the menu Book Now goes to /webstoreNew/services, and the two Book A Consultation buttons appear to use different destinations.
findings.cost: Different booking paths confuse clients and lose ready to book visitors.

findings.problem: The brand appears as 30 Hazelton Med Spa, 30H Med Spa and 30 Hazelton Spa, a testimonial spells it '30 Hazleton', and the footer shows 'Hazelton Av'.
findings.cost: Mixed names and misspellings weaken search visibility and polish.
findings.fix: One brand name and proofread copy.

findings.problem: Only four reviews appear, cut off mid sentence with no ratings or dates, and pricing shows only 'start at $380' for facials and lasers.
findings.cost: Thin proof and hidden prices lose clients who compare.
findings.fix: Full reviews with ratings and clear starting prices.

findings.problem: Two newsletter boxes appear with no visible submit button, the Strategic Partners heading appears to have no content, and the Skin menu item appears to link to the booking page.
findings.cost: Empty blocks and mislabeled links make a luxury brand look unfinished.
findings.fix: Working sign up form and correct menu links.

redesign: One booking path and one brand name.
Full reviews, ratings and starting prices.
Working forms and correct menu links.
